script.title: TOURING A VACANT APARTMENT
script.story_hook: Touring a vacant apartment with an agent.
script.intro_zh: 和經紀人一起參觀一間待租空屋。
script.welcome_en: Hi everyone, glad you came! Today we're touring an apartment.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨各位，謝謝你們來！今天我們來看一間公寓。
script.outro: That's all for today! Keep practicing and see you next time.
script.outro_zh: 今天就到這裡！繼續練習，下次見。
script.practice_intro_en: Now listen and repeat each sentence after me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟著我，一句一句聆聽並跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a neat young man in his late twenties with short wavy brown hair, wearing a light gray button shirt with rolled sleeves and dark chinos, holding car keys
script.char_b_description: a polished leasing agent in her thirties with straight black hair at her shoulders, wearing a crisp white blouse and a pencil skirt, holding a tablet
script.youtube_title: 【🏠看屋洽租🔑】「水電含在租金裡嗎？」租屋實用英文🚗聽完就會問｜Apartment Tour English
script.youtube_title_en: “Tour the One-Bedroom” — Asking About Utilities, Parking and Fees
script.youtube_description:

Touring a place to rent in English and not sure what to ask? This super-realistic apartment tour chat gets you ready in one listen. Follow the renter through the space, checking utilities and parking, the lease term, and the application fee — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA. Repeat every line in the second half and speak up today.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🏠看屋洽租英文｜確認水電・停車位・租約與申請費｜聽完就會問｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
第一次用英文看屋，卻不知道要問什麼？
水電、停車、租約與申請費，用英文怎麼說？

這一集帶大家走進一間待租空屋，跟著租客從參觀空間、確認水電與停車、詢問租約期限，到了解申請費用與線上填表，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🔑 參觀與開價：例如「tour the one-bedroom」、「Are utilities included in rent?」。
🚗 停車與租期：例如「Is parking included as well?」、「one spot, it's fifty extra」。
📝 申請費用：例如「What fee do I pay to apply?」、「a fifty-dollar application fee」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

看完記得實戰一次，原來看屋洽租可以這麼簡單！
script.thumbnail_action: looking around a bright living room

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm here to tour the one-bedroom.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm hɪr tu tʊr ði wʌn ˈbɛdˌrum/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我是來看那間一房一廳的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I'm Kelly, your leasing agent today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt aɪm ˈkɛli jɔr ˈlisɪŋ ˈeɪdʒənt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我是 Kelly，你的租賃顧問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you, I'm Kevin. Lead the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs tu miːt ju aɪm ˈkɛvɪn lid ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 很高興認識你，我是 Kevin，請帶路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's the living room, lots of sunlight.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪrz ðə ˈlɪvɪŋ rum lɑts əv ˈsaʊnˌlaɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, this space feels really open.
dialogue.zh: 哇，這個空間感覺很開闊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The kitchen has the newer appliances too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɪtʃən hæz ðə ˈnuər əˈplaɪənsɪz tu/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Love it. Are utilities included in rent?
dialogue.phonetic: /lʌv ɪt ɑr jəˈtɪlətiz ɪnˈkluːdɪd ɪn rɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 我好喜歡。水電包含在租金裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water and trash, but electric is yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtər ənd træʃ bʌt ɪˈlɛktrɪk ɪz jɔrz/
dialogue.zh: 自來水和垃圾，但電費是你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Is parking included as well?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ɪz ˈpɑrkɪŋ ɪnˈkluːdɪd æz wɛl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One spot, it's fifty extra per month.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn spɑt ɪts ˈfɪfti ˈɛkstrə pɜr mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 一個車位，每月多五十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's fine. How long is the lease term?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts faɪn haʊ lɔŋ ɪz ðə lis tɜrm/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。租約期限是多長？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv mʌnθs ˈstændərd mʌnθ tu mʌnθ ˈleɪtər/
dialogue.zh: 標準十二個月，之後可按月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. What fee do I pay to apply?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ wɑt fi du aɪ peɪ tu əˈplaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好。申請時我要付多少費用？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有一筆五十塊的申請費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair enough. Can I see the bedroom now?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr ɪˈnʌf kæn aɪ si ðə ˈbɛdˌrum naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 很合理。我現在能看臥室嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, right this way, mind the step.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs raɪt ðɪs weɪ maɪnd ðə stɛp/
dialogue.zh: 當然，請走這邊，小心台階。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is great, I'll start my application.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz ɡreɪt aɪl stɑrt maɪ ˌæpləˈkeɪʃən/
dialogue.zh: 這裡真棒，我要開始申請了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wonderful! I'll email the forms tonight.
dialogue.zh: 太好了！我今晚把表格 email 給你。
